baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated أصحاب at words 1 and 4 joins the repeated الميمنة at words 2 and 5 in a doubled nominal frame.
baseline_models.mechanism: The companionship branch makes a collective through durable association, while the right-hand/side branch locates that collective; repetition presents this as a stable identity worthy of acclamation rather than as a passing act.

activation_trace.role: Companionship and abiding association supply the bond that makes the members one company.
The right hand and right side supply the orienting side with which the company is identified.

changed_reading.after: A cohort constituted by durable association with the right-hand side, presented as an identity demanding astonished recognition.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أصحاب can carry preservative accompaniment, and الميمنة can carry blessing, within the same repeated construct.
baseline_models.mechanism: Blessing is read not merely as a favorable adjective but as a condition that accompanies and preserves the company.

activation_trace.role: Preservation through companionship turns association into a sustaining condition.
Blessing and felicity provide the beneficent quality being carried and preserved.

changed_reading.before: People who happen to be fortunate.
changed_reading.after: People whose shared company carries and preserves a beneficent condition.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus roots permit أصحاب as adherent accompaniment and الميمنة as oath, effective force, and right.
baseline_models.mechanism: The oath branch supplies a bond, the following branch supplies allegiance, and the force/right branch supplies effective authorization; together they permit an oath-bound company rather than a merely spatial one.

activation_trace.role: Following and yielding after resistance supply the company's adherent posture.
The oath branch supplies a covenantal bond rather than a direction.
Force, capacity, and the side of right supply the authority attached to that bond.

changed_reading.after: An oath-bound company whose adherence places it on the side of effective right and authority.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening event both falls into fixed occurrence and, through the split mapping, spreads over a level field; categorical negation and truth contrast make the subsequent company-name read as an irreversible placement in an exposed roster.

activation_trace.role: Stable association supplies the company that persists once the roster is fixed.
The right side supplies the position into which the company is arrayed.
Falling and becoming fixed turn the event into a settled condition.
The alternate mapped image of spreading on level ground supplies a displayed field for the sorting.
Categorical negation closes off escape from the event's stated condition.
The truth-versus-falsehood image makes the event and its resulting roster non-retractable.

structural_cues: 56:1 repeats w-q-a as event verb and event noun, and 56:2 repeats the event noun under negation before 56:7-10 names three groups.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fall/fix, level spread, and negated falsehood; I infer that the event fixes and displays the human roster. A live alternative is that these cues guarantee only the event, not the direction of assignment.

changed_reading.before: A company already located on a favorable side.
changed_reading.after: A company set down and openly arrayed on a definitive side by the occurring event.

context_deltas.mechanism: The paired lowering and raising recast right-sidedness as an outcome of vertical reversal, while the force/right branch allows elevation to carry authorization as well as location.

activation_trace.role: Companionship gathers those who undergo the same reversal into one company.
The right side supplies the focus position whose meaning is altered by the vertical pair.
Force and right let the raised position read as effective standing, not bare geometry.
Lowering after height supplies one pole of the rank reversal.
Elevation of standing supplies the other pole and makes the favorable side a raised status.

structural_cues: 56:3 consists of two opposed participles with no stated objects, leaving the named groups to instantiate the reversal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies down, up, side, and effective right; I infer a sorting that rights some by raising them. The live alternative is a purely cosmic upending with no direct rank assignment.

changed_reading.before: The company occupies a static right-hand location.
changed_reading.after: The company is righted into an elevated and effective standing by the great reversal.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context dismantles a solid elevated gathering into fine dispersed matter; against that material loss of cohesion, preservative companionship becomes a social form that remains gathered through collapse.

activation_trace.role: Abiding association supplies social cohesion after material cohesion fails.
Preservation through accompaniment supplies continuity across the collapse.
Breaking, moistening, and mixing dismantle the prior material integrity.
A hard elevated aggregation supplies the strongest image of stable gatheredness being lost.
Fine dispersed dust supplies the reduced state of the former solid gathering.
Scattering supplies the terminal loss of material cohesion.

structural_cues: 56:4-6 moves from earth and mountains to dispersed dust immediately before 56:7 says that the people become three groupings.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies solid gathering, disintegration, dispersal, and preservative companionship; I infer a contrast between failed material cohesion and surviving social cohesion. Alternatively, أصحاب may only label the post-collapse groups without explaining their persistence.

changed_reading.before: Companions are simply people sharing a side.
changed_reading.after: The right-side company is a preserved cohesion that emerges when the world's apparently firmer structures lose theirs.

context_deltas.mechanism: The category and peer-group branches of azwaj, explicitly numbered three, turn أصحاب from loose companionship into a formal class of like-associated persons.

activation_trace.role: Companionship supplies the internal bond of the named class.
The right side supplies the differentiating axis of the first class.
A kind or category supplies the taxonomic function of each following group-name.
Peers gathered by shared form or action explain why companionship marks class membership.
The number three fixes the roster rather than leaving an indefinite multitude.

structural_cues: 56:7 announces three azwaj, and 56:8, 56:9, and 56:10 then provide three parallel group labels.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies category, gathered peers, and the number three; I infer that 56:8 is the first formal roster entry. A live alternative is that azwaj stresses paired kinds rather than administrative classification.

changed_reading.before: A loose association of favorable individuals.
changed_reading.after: The first formally constituted peer class in a complete three-part human sorting.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact syntactic mirror in 56:9 places left-side and ill-omen branches opposite the focus's right-side and blessing branches, making spatial direction and valuation operate together.

activation_trace.role: Blessing supplies the favorable value pole.
The right side supplies the spatial pole.
The left side supplies the opposed spatial pole in the mirrored frame.
Ill omen supplies the opposed value pole.

structural_cues: 56:8 and 56:9 repeat the same أصحاب ... ما أصحاب ... construction while changing only the side-name.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies both directional and auspicial branches on opposite roots plus an exact syntactic mirror; I infer deliberate dual coding. Either physical side or moral fortune alone remains grammatically possible.

changed_reading.before: Right side and blessing are competing glosses.
changed_reading.after: The company occupies a polarity in which rightward placement and favorable valuation mutually interpret one another.

context_deltas.mechanism: A separately repeated group of those who advance is then identified as the specially brought-near retinue, limiting any baseline that equates the company of al-maymana with the entire or highest blessed elite.

activation_trace.role: Blessing supplies the favorable status that must now be distinguished from highest proximity.
Advancing and outstripping supply a separate superlative group.
The favored intimates of a ruler sharpen the distinct rank assigned to that group.

structural_cues: 56:10 gives the third group its own doubled naming formula, and 56:11 points back to that group before predicating special proximity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a distinct advancing group and the branch of privileged intimacy; I infer a hierarchy within favorable outcomes. The alternative is that the third label overlaps the company of al-maymana rather than forming a disjoint class.

changed_reading.before: The company of al-maymana is the undifferentiated apex of the blessed.
changed_reading.after: It is a favorable class whose standing does not erase the separately marked precedence and special proximity of the third group.

context_deltas.mechanism: Interwoven support, face-to-face arrangement, circulating service, and durable presence activate أصحاب as a designed relational topology: fellowship is spatially mutual, serviced by circulation, and stabilized over time.

activation_trace.role: Companionship supplies the social relation organized by the later spatial images.
Making things accompany one another allows fellowship to be read as an arranged system.
Tightly interwoven construction supplies the material analogy for linked fellowship.
Mutual facing makes the company reciprocal rather than merely co-located.
Circulation around the group supplies service flow through the relational arrangement.
Durable persistence supplies temporal stability to the arrangement.

structural_cues: 56:15-17 moves from woven supports to mutual facing and then circular service, but the passage follows the separately named third group without restating its subject.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies interweaving, facing, circulation, and durability; I transfer that topology back to the semantic potential of أصحاب. The materially live alternative is that these details characterize only the preceding group and should not be predicated directly of 56:8.

changed_reading.before: Company means only membership in the same category.
changed_reading.after: Company can name a stable social architecture of interconnection, mutual presence, and circulating care.

context_deltas.mechanism: Recompense answering deliberate work makes the force/right branch of al-maymana juridical: favorable placement is a fitting return. The split mapped image of cutting at ripeness adds an exploratory harvest-like closure rather than arbitrary luck.

activation_trace.role: Force, right, and the strongest claim supply the focus anchor for deserved standing.
Answering an act with its recompense supplies reciprocal assignment rather than chance.
The alternate mapped image of cutting at maturity supplies an exploratory harvest-like endpoint.
Intentional action supplies the conduct to which the return answers.

structural_cues: 56:24 explicitly links recompense with what they had been doing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reciprocal recompense, intentional work, and an alternate ripeness-cutting image; I infer that right-side standing can be read as fitting outcome. A live alternative is that the causal clause modifies only the preceding group's provisions.

changed_reading.before: The favorable side is a matter of auspice alone.
changed_reading.after: The company stands on the side of right as a reciprocal, harvest-like outcome of intentional action.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence removes bodily fracture and depletion, then removes worthless or guilt-loading speech, and finally leaves repeated safety and reconciliation; blessing through companionship becomes an ecology that preserves bodies and relations from being spent or split.

activation_trace.role: Preservation through companionship supplies the integrative function of the company.
Blessing supplies the positive condition now specified as non-depleting integrity.
Fracture and splitting supply the bodily failure that the context negates.
Discarded, uncounted matter supplies the futile speech excluded from the social environment.
Loading or charging another with guilt supplies the relational injury that is absent.
Safety from defects supplies the positive replacement for fracture and depletion.
Reconciliation against conflict supplies the positive replacement for injurious speech.

structural_cues: 56:19 negates two bodily effects, 56:25 negates two speech effects, and 56:26 follows with an exclusive doubled سلام.
The n-z-f occurrence at 56:19 word 5 is branchless in the packet, so its depletion sense supports the pattern structurally but is not used as a branch citation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fracture, branchless depletion, futile speech, guilt-loading, safety, and reconciliation; I infer one non-depleting bodily and social ecology. The live alternative is that all these effects belong only to the separately brought-near group.

changed_reading.after: Blessed companionship denotes a preserved field in which neither bodies nor relations are fractured, depleted, or poisoned by speech.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the rare y-m-n death branch reverses the dominant blessing and right-side readings. It remains anchored directly in الميمنة and is activated by the collapse sequence's h-b-w branch that also carries death; downstream prose should present it only as a mortality-shadowed secondary activation, never as a replacement lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: الميمنة at words 2 and 5 carries a supplied branch in which being laid on the right is associated with death, while أصحاب permits something made accompanying.

activation_trace.role: The rare death-by-right-side branch introduces mortality into the focus term itself.
Making something accompany another lets mortality be carried as the company's accompanying horizon.
The context branch of flight or death activates the otherwise remote mortality potential of y-m-n.

changed_reading.before: The company is defined only by blessing or rightward honor.
changed_reading.after: At the exploratory edge, it is the company whose assigned side carries death as the threshold through which the sorting becomes manifest.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain material analogy is surprising because it activates the s-h-b image of hide retaining hair during flaying or tanning. It remains focus-anchored in أصحاب and gains contextual force from crushing and dispersal; downstream prose should qualify it as an analogy for attachment under stripping, not a literal claim about bodies or hides.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أصحاب at words 1 and 4 carries the supplied branch of a hide on which hair or wool remains attached.

activation_trace.role: A hide retaining hair through stripping supplies the material image of attachment that survives processing.
Force and right supply the holding claim that keeps the company attached to its side.
Breaking and mixing supply the destructive processing against which retained attachment matters.
Scattering supplies the loss of attachment that this outlier imagines the company resisting.

changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, the company is a retained layer that stays attached to its rightful side while surrounding structures are stripped and scattered.

strongest_changes: The lower/raise pair in 56:3 turns right from a static side into event-produced elevation and righting.
The threefold roster in 56:7-11 makes أصحاب a formal peer class while delimiting it from the separately advancing and brought-near group.
The collapse and no-fracture/no-harm sequence recasts blessed companionship as preserved cohesion and non-depletion.
The recompense-for-work clause permits right-side standing to read as reciprocal and rightful rather than auspicious by chance alone.
summary.what_was_special: The most productive activation was the tension between s-h-b as durable or preservative accompaniment and a context that first pulverizes stable structures, then reorganizes people, relations, return, and speech.
remaining_uncertainties: Verses 12-26 most immediately continue the separately brought-near group, so their images may activate the focus term without directly predicating its company.
The relative weight of direction, blessing, force/right, and oath within y-m-n remains unresolved; the trace preserves them as distinct readings.
The spatial-field and harvest arrows from the split w-q-a/q-w-a and j-z-y/j-z-z mappings are intentionally exploratory.
